system.description:
• Effect: Identify plants and animals perfectly within the Druid's trained region.
  • Determine if water is safe to drink
  • Find basic shelter and enough food for one person automatically
  • Feeding additional people takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds an extra 2d4 people
  • Unfamiliar regions require a Wisdom check for all of the above

activities.name: Nature Lore
activities.text: Identify plants and animals, judge water, or forage; automatic in your trained region, a Wisdom check elsewhere or to feed extra people.
